method: Three fresh-process optimized runs per variant/window count, alternating variant order. 100 edits and 10 flush samples per run. Same pilot content. Memory sampled after 500 ms idle; no forced GC. RSS is summed, not physical footprint. Paint is approximated by two animation-frame callbacks. JS acknowledgement is local replica acceptance; native acknowledgement crosses the bridge. Network checks finish before benchmarks; benchmarks have networking disabled. End-to-end network timings are individual wall-clock samples including native flush and harness polling, not percentiles.
